Name: MORE Emily Revised - Seasonal - COMPLETED FESTIVAL OUTFITS
Author: smartichoke
Description:
Emily time B)

I've got another set of festival outfits for y'all - this time for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9952]stanloona420's version of Emily[/url]! It functions exactly the same as their file, so follow their instructions and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit[/url] mod to use the files. I have also included a tutorial under the video tab of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25539]my edits for Haley[/url]! The process will be a little different because Haley had some exceptions to my preferred method of editing, but otherwise its the same steps. Just don't skip stanloona420's portraits! If you have any questions, let me know!! I'm always happy to help!



[b]THIS IS NOT A MOD, THIS IS JUST THE IMAGE FILES.[/b] You will need to replace the images within another mod to use them.



[size=3]There are 2 versions![/size]

[list]
[*]The sprites in V1 are visually matched to the style that stanloona420 used
in their files. You will need to download stanloona420's file to complete the set of sprites. I did not edit the sprites for their seasonal outfits.[/list]
[list]
[*]The sprites in V2 are color matched to the portraits along with some personal preference edits. They are also noseless. There are additional files that contain the noses that can be configured in if you are using Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit mod! This also includes sprites for the seasonal outfits for consistency.
There is also an optional alternative outfit for the midnight jellies festival! She's cosplaying as a character from a Miyazaki film, but its a bit obscure of a reference so I decided not to use it as the default outfit for that festival. IYKYK... [i]whispers: She's supposed to be Granmamere from Ponyo![/i][/list]
I made most of these edits WEEKS ago, but I kept noticing small details that I wanted to change so this took much longer than I anticipated. As much as I love Emily, we have beef now. Her face stresses me out.

As always, let me know if there are any inconsistencies or issues! I haven't had a chance to do a super in depth look within the game and all of the cutscenes to make sure everything looks right.

Downloads.Description: V1 uses sprites that visually match stanloona420's sprites. NOT a full set of the sprites or portraits. You will need to download their file to complete the set.
V2 contains sprites that just have some personal preference touches. This file includes sprites for the seasonal outfits for consistency.

Just an alternative design for the midnight jellies festival. This file has both v1 and v2 files in it, so pick 1 and delete the other. It's supposed to be a cosplay of Granmamare from Miyazaki's Ponyo but it felt like a bit of an obscure reference lol
